visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male performer in a white short-sleeved shirt and loose patterned trousers energetically plays a red electric guitar on a stage illuminated by vibrant yellow and green spotlights. (2) Close-up shots feature golden-brown fried snacks in a wire fryer basket, followed by a small bowl of steamed rice topped with savory braised pork and sauce. (3) A sequence showing various festival elements: a crowd raising hands in front of a stage, a large colorful wooden archway with decorative masks, and a young woman in a lace top smiling at a table during a signing event. (4) Footage moves to an outdoor park area where people climb on a large red rope net structure and walk through a market with many white peak-top tents. (5) A young boy tosses a red frisbee in a park setting, followed by a wide shot of a futuristic blue stage erected directly in front of a traditional Chinese temple with ornate roofs and red lanterns. (6) A large board displays a food map, people sit on picnic blankets on a grassy field, and individuals walk past traditional street food stalls and small boutique shops. (7) At night, a band performs on a large outdoor stage with a screen displaying 'KROI', while attendees wearing green cloaks cheer and a white dog stands on the pavement. (8) A static outro screen appears with pink and white branding, including social media icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube alongside website URLs.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional travelogue and recap for the 'Emerge Fest' 2025 music festival in Qingshui, Taichung. By showcasing a blend of Japanese rock performances, local Taiwanese street food, and family-friendly park activities, it aims to highlight the unique 'local co-prosperity' theme of the event and encourage viewers to attend in the following year.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly promotes the 'Emerge Fest' (浮現祭) 2025 and directs viewers to the brand's Instagram link for more information.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes high-speed rhythmic editing synchronized with J-Rock music to create a sense of excitement. It successfully bridges contemporary youth music culture with traditional local scenery (the temple stage).
